key_insight: RoleFlow improves multi-agent collaboration by learning targeted structural edits and synthesizing roles on demand instead of relying on fixed workflows.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive agent workflows could help engineering assistants adjust collaboration to changing reasoning, coding, and web-interaction tasks.
method: Refine collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits.
Synthesize new agent roles on demand.
Use SECPO to compare each edit with a no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and credit edit-specific tokens.
evidence_signal: Across seven benchmarks in four domains, the abstract reports a 4.7-point average lead over the strongest competitor and 3.2–7.5 F1-point leads on three multi-hop QA benchmarks.
watch_item: Counterfactual edit evaluation may add execution cost; the abstract does not quantify this overhead.
paper_title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
